Package org.apache.juneau.commons.svl

Record Class TemplateReference

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.juneau.commons.svl.TemplateReference
Record Components:
kind - What was referenced.
name - The var prefix (P for the ${name} shortcut), the function name (operators are $op.*), the identifier, or for TemplateReference.Kind.SYNTAX the error message.
bound - Whether the name resolves in the resolver the template was compiled against: a registered var, or a registered function permitted by the allowlist. Always true for identifiers.
listName - For an identifier read as a row field (inside the body of a select or projection whose target is a top-level identifier), that identifier's name; null for a top-level identifier. Identifiers in a body whose target is anything else are not reported.
start - Start offset, inclusive.
end - End offset, exclusive.
public record TemplateReference(TemplateReference.Kind kind, String name, boolean bound, String listName, int start, int end) extends Record
One reference found in a compiled VarTemplate: a ${...} var, a function or operator call, an identifier, or a syntax problem.

Offsets are into VarTemplate.getSource(): start inclusive, end exclusive. For a var the span is the whole ${...} marker; a ${name} or ${name:default} var reference also yields an TemplateReference.Kind.IDENT entry for its key (the text before the first top-level :); for a function and an identifier it is the name token; for a syntax problem it is the offending marker.

References are reported for markers that are evaluated at render time. A stable var folded at compile time (and an expression folded with it) has no entry. A ${...} inside a nested var body is not analyzed.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
